rustfmt.command: nix develop --command rustfmt --config skip_children=true --edition 2024 <three isolated draft files>
rustfmt.initial_attempt: Without skip_children, rustfmt stopped because unchanged child active.rs was not copied into isolated draft. No source or compiler failure.

compile: NOT RUN: production/native source freeze active; draft requires parent isolated verified native APIs
tests: NOT RUN: two new wrapper tests are planned for the coordinated release gate, alongside existing scheduler/final-audit and lower-loop numerical regressions
